milestones.title: Foundation (Week 1)
milestones.description: Project skeleton, config, Flyway baseline, shared infrastructure.

milestones.title: Auth (Week 2)
milestones.description: JWT auth, refresh rotation, admin user management.

milestones.title: Product (Week 3)
milestones.description: Product catalog + seller management + admin moderation.

milestones.title: Order (Week 4)
milestones.description: Order creation, customer order APIs, seller fulfillment, admin overrides.

issues.title: [EPIC] Foundation
issues.body:
Establish a production-ready Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 modular monolith foundation for Vendora.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Application boots with no errors
- Flyway runs successfully against PostgreSQL
- Base endpoints respond as expected

issues.title: [EPIC] Auth
issues.body: Implement JWT auth (access + refresh rotation), roles (CUSTOMER/SELLER/ADMIN), and admin user management.

issues.title: [EPIC] Product
issues.body: Implement product catalog + inventory with Customer/Seller/Admin separation.

issues.title: [EPIC] Order
issues.body: Implement orders with atomic stock decrement, customer order APIs, seller fulfillment, and admin overrides.

issues.title: [EPIC] Testing
issues.body: Add unit + integration + controller tests using JUnit 5, Mockito, and Testcontainers.

issues.title: [EPIC] Docker & Deployment
issues.body: Containerize app and provide docker-compose for local and prod-like runs.

issues.title: [EPIC] Documentation & Cleanup
issues.body: Write portfolio-grade docs and perform cleanup/polish.

issues.title: Project initialization and strict modular package structure
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Foundation

Initialize the vendora backend as Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 / Maven and create the strict modular package structure under `com.vendora.modules.*`.

Acceptance Criteria:
- App starts without errors
- Swagger UI loads and shows health endpoint
- Package structure matches spec

issues.title: Base configuration (profiles, PostgreSQL, logging)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Foundation

Create `application.yml` plus `application-dev.yml` and `application-prod.yml` with env-var based DB config and production-safe logging.

issues.title: Global API error handling contract
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Foundation

Implement consistent JSON error responses via `@RestControllerAdvice` for validation and domain exceptions.

issues.title: CORS configuration for frontend integration
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Foundation

Configure CORS to allow frontend applications from different origins.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Frontend can call API from configured origins
- Origins configurable via env var

issues.title: Spring Boot Actuator + operational endpoints
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Foundation

Add Spring Boot Actuator for health checks and operational monitoring.

Acceptance Criteria:
- /actuator/health returns UP
- /actuator/info shows app info
- Other endpoints secured

issues.title: Flyway baseline migrations (schema init)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Foundation

Create `V1__init.sql` with all tables, constraints, and indexes as per design.

issues.title: Seed roles and admin bootstrap strategy
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Foundation

Create `V2__seed_roles.sql` and document admin bootstrap strategy.

issues.title: Spring Security baseline + role model
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Auth

Add stateless security baseline for APIs, role-based authorization, and password encoder.

issues.title: Auth domain + persistence (users, roles, refresh tokens)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Auth

Implement entities + repositories for users/roles/refresh tokens (refresh stored hashed).

issues.title: JWT implementation (access + refresh rotation)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Auth

Implement JWT access token issuance/validation and refresh token rotation with revocation.

issues.title: Auth REST API (register/login/refresh/logout/me/change-password)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Auth

Implement auth endpoints with DTO validation and correct error codes.

issues.title: Admin user management API (list users, roles, activate/deactivate)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Auth

Implement admin endpoints to list/search users, update status, and manage roles.

issues.title: Seller profile management APIs (CRUD)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Auth

Allow sellers to create and manage their profile.

Acceptance Criteria:
- SELLER can create/view/update own profile
- Profile includes display name and phone

issues.title: Product domain + persistence (categories, products, images)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Product

Implement product entities and repositories with product status and stock constraints.

issues.title: Public product APIs (browse, detail, search/filter)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Product

Implement public product browse and detail endpoints with paging/filtering; only ACTIVE visible.

issues.title: Seller product management APIs (create/update/list/activate)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Product

Implement seller endpoints to manage own products; enforce ownership and module boundaries.

issues.title: Admin product moderation API (activate/deactivate)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Product

Implement admin endpoint to change product status.

issues.title: Category management APIs (CRUD)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Product

Implement category management for admins and public listing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Public can list all categories
- Only ADMIN can create/update/delete
- Handle products referencing deleted categories

issues.title: Order domain + persistence (orders + order_items)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Order

Implement order entities and repositories with shipping snapshot + item snapshots.

issues.title: Order creation transaction (stock validation + atomic decrement)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Order

Implement transactional order creation with stock validation and safe decrement to prevent overselling.

issues.title: Customer order APIs (create/list/detail/cancel)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Order

Implement customer order endpoints and cancel rules with strict ownership enforcement.

issues.title: Seller order view APIs + fulfillment status updates
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Order

Implement seller endpoints to view orders containing their items and update fulfillment status for their items only.

issues.title: Admin order APIs (list all, status override)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Order

Implement admin endpoints to list all orders and override status.

issues.title: Unit tests for service layer (Mockito)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Testing

Add service unit tests for auth/product/order core rules.

issues.title: Integration tests with Testcontainers PostgreSQL
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Testing

Add Testcontainers-based integration tests validating Flyway + repositories + transactional order creation.

issues.title: Controller/security tests (MockMvc)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Testing

Add MockMvc tests for security rules (401/403) and validation (400).

issues.title: Dockerfile (multi-stage) for vendora backend
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Docker & Deployment

Add a multi-stage Dockerfile to build and run the app with Java 21.

issues.title: docker-compose (app + postgres) for local and prod-like runs
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Docker & Deployment

Add docker-compose for app + Postgres with env-var configuration and volumes.

issues.title: GitHub Actions CI pipeline (test + build)
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Docker & Deployment

Set up GitHub Actions to run tests on PRs and build Docker image.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Tests run automatically on PR
- Docker image builds on main push
- Failures block PR merge

issues.title: Documentation: README + architecture + API docs strategy
issues.body:
Epic: [EPIC] Documentation & Cleanup

Write portfolio-grade README, module boundary rules, and API documentation strategy (OpenAPI).
